verdicts.explanation: The paper states the room-temperature conductivity of Li6PTeS4Cl as 91 mS cm-1 (listed first, before Li6.25PTeS4.25Cl0.75 at 126). The values come from this paper's AIMD/Nernst-Einstein analysis, so computational is correct, and the 0.175 eV activation energy is the AIMD value for Li6PTeS4Cl.

The paper quotes 14 mS cm-1 for Li6.25PS5.25Cl0.75 with citation marker 22 and attributes it to earlier work (the AIMD study on Li6PS5Cl), so literature_cited is correct. The temperature is given only as room temperature, so the null Celsius value is acceptable.
